sources.title: Jaaaaa Hurraaaaa.wav
sources.creator: Davidox
sources.description: Author describes Happy swedish boy. First Ja vowel ~0.80–1.64s, second Hurra-shaped two-syllable vocalization ~1.70–3.35s. Suggested crop 1.68–3.48s. ASR is unreliable on this shouted voice; Swedish base model outputs Ja then Ha ha ha. Check audition before choosing.
